title: SMTP config.validate() missing bcrypt hash check — from_credentials panics instead of clean error
description: smtp::Config::validate() does not check auth.users passwords with looks_like_bcrypt_hash. smtp::server.rs calls CredentialStore::from_credentials(&config.auth.users) which panics if any password is not a valid bcrypt hash. Reader and IMAP both added the check to their validate() (commits 4fa767e, 7eee338). SMTP was missed. Trigger: operator sets plaintext password in SMTP [auth.users]. Actual behavior: process panics at startup with a Rust panic message instead of a ConfigError::Validation with a helpful operator-facing message. The from_credentials doc precondition says 'The standard startup path in each service binary calls Config::validate() before constructing a CredentialStore' — this is false for SMTP.
